WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind AS trader_type,
    ab.translink,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind, ab.translink
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    translink,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS share
  FROM combination_counts
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    record_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  trader_type,
  AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_margin_over_type_average_share
FROM classified
WHERE share > average_share
GROUP BY trader_type;
